label: Detail
description: Close structural details — the tight second shot of every architecture essay.

items.name: spiral-stair-eye
items.text: a stone spiral staircase seen straight down its own eye, treads fanning into a nautilus curve, the handrail drawing one continuous line

items.name: fan-vault
items.text: fan vaulting spreading from clustered piers, stone ribs opening like palm fronds to meet in carved bosses

items.name: dome-oculus
items.text: a coffered dome pierced by an open oculus, one solid beam of light crossing the interior dark

items.name: muqarnas-vault
items.text: a muqarnas vault dripping honeycomb tiers of carved plaster, each cell cupping its own gradation of shadow

items.name: cast-iron-capital
items.text: a cast-iron column capital of painted acanthus leaves, bolt heads honest beneath the ornament, factory glazing behind

items.name: cantilever-stair
items.text: floating stone stair treads cantilevered from a bare wall, shadow gaps beating a rising rhythm

items.name: shoji-track
items.text: shoji screens sliding on worn timber tracks, paper panes glowing with even diffused light

items.name: rose-window-interior
items.text: a rose window seen from inside, tracery in black silhouette, colored light staining the stone floor below

items.name: space-frame-node
items.text: a machined steel space-frame node, eight tube struts meeting in bolted precision against the skylight

items.name: hammer-beam-roof
items.text: a medieval hammer-beam roof, blackened oak trusses flying across the hall on carved angel corbels

items.name: flying-buttress
items.text: a rank of flying buttresses leaping from nave wall to outer pier, each arc carrying the vault's thrust down to the ground, crockets bristling along the copings

items.name: waffle-slab
items.text: a raw concrete waffle-slab ceiling, square coffers in a strict grid, clerestory light sliding a diagonal of shadow across one cell after another

items.name: catalan-vault
items.text: a thin-shell Catalan brick vault, herringbone tile courses curving overhead without a single formwork mark, the whole shell barely a hand-span thick at the crown

items.name: dovetail-log-corner
items.text: a dovetailed log-cabin corner, axe-hewn timbers interlocking without a nail, moss chinking pressed into the gaps between courses
